title: Negative-space analysis — authoritative results only (VOS/IGF/CGC/KFC/AGS)

VOS.hypothesis: Skipping cold (<10% visible) Gaussian optimizer updates reduces workload without quality loss
VOS.headroom: ~-40.2% logical update reduction; optimizer ~15-19% of step; ideal wall ceiling 1.183x
VOS.real_implementation_result: VIABLE(k=4) at optimizer-step level (econ geomean 0.251, pooled median PSNR loss -0.014 dB) BUT VOS1 hardened full 30K + true-holdout = QUALITY_FAIL
VOS.failure_mechanism: Amdahl-bound: SparseGaussianAdam is O(N), cutting update COUNT does not cut wall time; measured wall ~1.004x; room seed-0 -0.271 dB

IGF.hypothesis: Importance-freeze scheduler (freeze low-importance Gaussians after warmup) preserves quality with less work
IGF.failure_mechanism: No CUDA kernel (pure-PyTorch sparse step slower end-to-end, 0.46-0.92x); importance model does not transfer across scene complexity

CGC.hypothesis: Candidate-generation pruning reduces Gaussians with fidelity preserved
CGC.failure_mechanism: Fidelity gates (SSIM/grad-cos/LPIPS) fail at every threshold on every scene; rasterize overhead-bound; no trained ckpt for garden/bicycle

KFC.hypothesis: Fused kernel reduces memory traffic / kernel-launch overhead
KFC.failure_mechanism: Fused kernel cannot launch on real workload (804KB shared >> 164KB A100 max); bwd compute-bound; autograd boundary blocks E2E; KFC0 DRAM claim disproven

AGS.hypothesis: Incremental tile-sort repair avoids full radix sort
AGS.failure_mechanism: 0% tile reuse; incremental repair 2.18x slower than radix; garden/bicycle ckpts missing

note: Summarizes ONLY authoritative results. No new GPU work.
